ingredients.title: Soup mixture
items: 1 can (10.75 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup
1/3 cup soft jalapeño cream cheese
3/4 cup sour cream
1/2 cup milk

ingredients.title: Filling
items: 1 Tbsp butter
2 cups chopped chicken breast
1 onion, chopped
1 tsp dried cilantro
1 tsp chili powder
1 can (4 oz) chopped green chile peppers, drained

ingredients.title: Assembly
items: 8 flour tortillas (8 inch)
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a small bowl mix the soup, cream cheese, and sour cream; set aside.
Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sauté until cooked.
Add onion, cilantro and chili powder, and sauté until tender.
Add chile peppers and 1/2 of the soup mixture. Cook and stir until heated through.
Add milk to remaining soup mixture.
Grease a 9x13 pan. Spread 1/2 cup of the soup mixture in the baking dish.
Spoon about 1/4 cup of the chicken mixture down the center of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, and place, seam-side-down, in the baking dish.
Spoon remaining soup mixture on top, and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 30-40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until bubbly and lightly browned.
